desc.zh: 从前置字符的手算出发，推导最长回文前缀与 KMP 回退。
desc.en: Derive the longest palindromic prefix and KMP fallback from a tiny prepend puzzle.

complexity: O(n) time; O(n) auxiliary space and output space

concepts.name: Longest palindromic prefix
concepts.description: Reduce prepend-only palindrome construction to an equal prefix and suffix.

concepts.name: KMP prefix function fallback
concepts.description: Retain matched borders and fall back without rechecking known characters.
